name: rmod
description: Local LLM monitor: shows whether Ollama and LM Studio are listening, counts this session's local requests, and lists local models.

enableOllama.title: Monitor Ollama
enableOllama.description: Probe the local Ollama server. When off, Ollama shows as 'off' and is never probed.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Loopback URL of Ollama (127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost only). Leave empty to use OLLAMA_HOST if it is loopback, else http://127.0.0.1:11434.

enableLmStudio.title: Monitor LM Studio
enableLmStudio.description: Probe the local LM Studio server. When off, LM Studio shows as 'off' and is never probed.

lmstudioUrl.title: LM Studio URL
lmstudioUrl.description: Loopback URL of the LM Studio server (127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost only).

lmstudioApiToken.title: LM Studio API token
lmstudioApiToken.description: Optional. Only needed when LM Studio's 'require API token' is on. Stored in the macOS Keychain and sent only to the LM Studio URL.

pollIntervalSec.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSec.description: How often to probe each server.

probeTimeoutMs.title: Probe timeout (ms)
probeTimeoutMs.description: A probe with no answer within this time counts as not listening.

modelsRefreshSec.title: Model list refresh (seconds)
modelsRefreshSec.description: How often to refresh the model inventory while a server is up.

showBand.title: Show status band
showBand.description: Initial default for the band above the prompt. The pane's Hide/Show button overrides it and is remembered.

localMcpServerNames.title: Local MCP server names
localMcpServerNames.description: Comma-separated words. An MCP tool counts as a local request when its server name contains one, in any letter case (for example ollama, lmstudio). Literal words, not a regular expression. Narrow it if a server such as ollama-docs is not local.
